sampling: daily at 12:00 UTC, identical every year

record_window.means: every record claim in this file is scoped to 1991-2026 and must be stated that way. ERA5 itself begins in 1940; saying 'the ERA5 record' while computing a shorter window overclaims by the difference. Never 'warmest ever'.

august.caution: the margin over second place is small. A different SST product could reorder the top two. The anomaly is the robust figure; the ranking is not.

largest_anomaly_day.means: the day in 2026 when the sea was furthest above its own normal, which is not the day it was warmest
